description: The Odyssey, Part II: The House of Ithaca. Covers A homeland hidden by a goddess; Eumaeus and the welcome that asks no proof; A son's journey back; What it means to come home.

setting.label: c. 1200 BCE · conventional Trojan heroic frame
setting.note: Conventional Bronze Age frame for the Trojan War and its aftermath; this is a sorting anchor, not a claim that the war or marvelous voyages happened in this year. The poems mix periods. Their formation and surviving witnesses are separate. See discovery-homeric-setting and the 013000 opening; British Museum Troy exhibition notes that Homer’s war has not been established as a historical event.
